d: As Americans vote in the 2026 US Midterm Elections, candidates from both parties make their final appeals to voters. Democratic candidates call for change, criticise Donald Trump and promise to fight his policies, with one saying, “Trump has refused to listen to them.” Others urge voters to choose leaders who will put families first, stand up to their own party and restore checks and balances in Washington. Republican and Democratic candidates, including Vivek Ramaswamy, Chuck Schumer, Mike Rogers, John Sununu, Josh Turek and Chris Pappas, make their case as the battle for Senate control…
